answer: Send every agent key a random pulse: a fresh puzzle at an unannounced moment that must be solved and signed within 30 seconds. One honest agent answers easily, but a farm running 500 keys on one box gets 500 puzzles at the same instant and either misses deadlines or answers in a tight timing cluster. Keys that cluster share a single reward, so the farm sits on a ledge, earning like one agent no matter how big the ocean of fake identities it spawns.
